# Ekbatan Tech (شرکت مهندسی زیرساخت اکباتان)

> Enterprise Platform Engineering, Cloud-Native Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Ceph Storage, High-Throughput CDN, MLOps/GPU Clusters, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in Tehran, Iran.

## Core Services
- [Enterprise Kubernetes & Bare-Metal](https://ekbatan.tech/services/kubernetes/): HA control plane, Cilium eBPF CNI, GitOps, CIS hardening.
- [Ceph Distributed Storage](https://ekbatan.tech/services/ceph/): Multi-petabyte Block (RBD), File (CephFS), and Object (S3/RGW) via cephadm & Rook-Ceph.
- [Enterprise Distributed Databases](https://ekbatan.tech/services/enterprise-databases/): HA PostgreSQL (Patroni/CloudNativePG), ClickHouse, StarRocks, Kafka.
- [Elasticsearch Enterprise & Observability](https://ekbatan.tech/services/elasticsearch-enterprise/): ECK Operator, Hot-Warm-Cold ILM, Vector, OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics.
- [Edge CDN & Networking](https://ekbatan.tech/services/edge-cdn-networking/): Anycast BGP, Envoy xDS Go controllers, NUMA/kTLS Nginx tuning for Tbps video streaming.
- [MLOps & GPU AI Clusters](https://ekbatan.tech/services/mlops-ai-clusters/): HPE Gen11, NVIDIA H200/NVLink, MIG, vLLM, KServe, MLflow.
- [Enterprise DevOps & GitLab CI/CD](https://ekbatan.tech/services/enterprise-devops-gitlab/): GitLab Enterprise, ArgoCD GitOps, KEDA, Kaniko, LLM-assisted code review.

## Enterprise Deployment Catalog
- [Enterprise Stacks Hub](https://ekbatan.tech/enterprise/): Reference HA Kubernetes architectures for GitLab, Elasticsearch (ECK), Jira Data Center, Confluence Data Center, n8n Queue Mode, JFrog Artifactory, Nexus Repository, Mattermost, Nextcloud, and Unleash.
